description: This file defines the CobaltTextToSpeechHelper class, which implements text-to-speech and accessibility features for audio accessibility, including handling screen reader state changes and speech synthesis control.

classes.name: CobaltTextToSpeechHelper
classes.description: Helper class for implementing text-to-speech and accessibility features, managing TTS engine lifecycle, and responding to accessibility state changes.

methods.name: isScreenReaderEnabled
methods.description: Checks if a screen reader is currently enabled.

methods.name: onInit
methods.description: Callback for TTS engine initialization status.

methods.name: speak
methods.description: Speaks the provided text, enqueuing if necessary.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Stops all ongoing speech and clears pending utterances.

methods.name: onTouchExplorationStateChanged
methods.description: Handles changes in touch exploration (talkback) state.

methods.name: finishIfScreenReaderChanged
methods.description: Detects changes in screen reader status and triggers event if changed.
